def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Grid junctions are the regularly spaced rows and columns that are
    # otherwise the separator color. Find repeated separator intervals.
    def line_positions(seq):
        return [i for i, x in enumerate(seq) if x == 3]

    # In each row/column, separators recur at fixed intervals; detect
    # rows and columns with a high proportion of color 3.
    rlines = [r for r in range(h) if sum(x == 3 for x in grid[r]) >= w - 3]
    clines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)) >= h - 3]

    # The junction locations are the lattice intersections; retain the
    # actual values there, then trim rows/columns without colored markers.
    lattice = [[grid[r][c] for c in clines] for r in rlines]
    if not lattice:
        return [[3]]
    active_r = [i for i, row in enumerate(lattice) if any(x not in (3, 9) for x in row)]
    active_c = [j for j in range(len(clines))
                if any(lattice[i][j] not in (3, 9) for i in range(len(lattice)))]
    if not active_r or not active_c:
        return [[3]]
    return [[lattice[i][j] for j in active_c] for i in active_r]
